about: Hacker News (news.ycombinator.com): read front page, new, past, Ask, Show and jobs listings, stories with comment trees, comment feeds, user profiles, submissions, comments and favorites, and post comments. Every command parses the server-rendered HTML.

commands.summary: List ranked stories from a Hacker News feed: front page (news), Ask HN, Show HN, best, or most active. Page-numbered.

params.name: feed
params.description: Which feed to list: news = front page, ask = Ask HN, show = Show HN, best = highest-voted recent stories, active = most active discussions

params.name: p
params.description: Page number, 1-based, 30 stories per page

params.name: h
params.description: Only for feed=best: look-back window in hours

commands.summary: List the newest submissions, newest Ask HN, newest Show HN, or job postings, in chronological order.

params.name: feed
params.description: newest = all new links, asknew = new Ask HN, shownew = new Show HN, jobs = job postings

params.name: next
params.description: Pagination cursor: the item id from the page's 'More' link (normally the id of the last item shown). Omit for the first page.

params.name: n
params.description: Rank number for the first item on the next page (e.g. 31). Use together with next.

commands.summary: List the stories that were on the Hacker News front page on a given past day.

params.name: day
params.description: Day in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-10-15

params.name: p
params.description: Page number, 1-based

commands.summary: List Hacker News submissions from a given domain or site path (e.g. github.com/antirez).

params.name: site
params.description: Domain or site path as HN shows it next to titles, e.g. nytimes.com or github.com/antirez

params.name: next
params.description: Pagination cursor: the item id from the 'More' link

params.name: n
params.description: Rank number of the first item on the next page, e.g. 31

commands.summary: Get one story, Ask/Show post or comment by id: title, link, points, author, age, comment count and body text.

params.name: id
params.description: Hacker News item id (story or comment)

commands.summary: List the comment tree of a story or comment (flattened in thread order, with indent depth).

params.name: id
params.description: Hacker News item id whose comments to list

params.name: p
params.description: Page of comments, for very large threads

commands.summary: List the newest comments across Hacker News, with the story each one is on.

params.name: next
params.description: Pagination cursor: the comment id from the page's 'More' link

commands.summary: List the most-upvoted comments of the last N hours (48 by default).

params.name: h
params.description: Look-back window in hours. The site uses 48 when this is omitted.

params.name: p
params.description: Page number

commands.summary: Get a Hacker News user's profile: username, account creation date, karma and about text, as label/value rows.

params.name: id
params.description: HN username (case-sensitive)

commands.summary: List the stories a user has submitted, newest first.

params.name: id
params.description: HN username

params.name: next
params.description: Pagination cursor: the item id from the 'More' link

params.name: n
params.description: Rank number of the first item on the next page, e.g. 31

commands.summary: List a user's recent comments, with the story each one is on.

params.name: id
params.description: HN username

params.name: next
params.description: Pagination cursor: the comment id from the page's 'More' link

commands.summary: List the top 100 Hacker News users by karma, in rank order.
List Hacker News's special listing pages (front, best, active, leaders, etc.) with descriptions.
